verdict.overall: The biggest mover since Sunday is APP, up almost 19% into today's earnings and flipping to resistance (OPPOSING) with very pricey options — the riskiest setup here. TSLA, PLTR and AMAT all drifted lower with falling magnet levels, weakening their range trades, while SPY and QQQ stay the calmest, best-anchored setups, with SPY even turning supportive for 11-13. Confidence in the index trades is rising; confidence in single stocks is fading given falling prices, upcoming earnings (NVDA, AMAT, ZETA), and pricey options chains.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price fell 3.7% to $385; the nearest week eased to neutral but floor and ceiling slid to $380/$410, and the next three weeks stay OPPOSING with a steady $380 magnet. Options trading was unusually busy today near the magnet, so near-term levels may shift.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: weaker. Price dropped 6.7% to $172 and every expiry's magnet and floor slid lower (nearest floor now $150, down from $180), showing support levels being dragged down with the stock. Still a neutral chain, but the steady drift lower across all four weeks is a caution sign.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: little changed in levels though price eased 2.2% to $200; the nearest expiry flipped to supportive with its magnet down to $207.5 and floor holding at $200. Earnings land 11-17, inside this window, and options are pricey across all four weeks — a real risk around that date.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: little changed, price up 2% to $31.78. The nearest expiry stays neutral near a $32.5 magnet, but the 11-13 week flipped to OPPOSING with its magnet down to $31. Earnings land 11-09, inside this window, and options here are very pricey — expect choppy moves.

tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: little changed. Price is flat near $325, all four weeks stay neutral, and magnets, floors and ceilings only drifted modestly (nearest floor up to $325, ceiling steady near $355). A calm, well-anchored chain for range trading.
